findingClass: a settled ipos field (price band, lot, issue size, face value, open/close/listing/allotment date, registrar, lead managers) re-stamped by an identical value, rewritten by a source the writer ranks equal or lower, or changed by the source that set it without a refresh right, after the best-ranked source has set it (OD-73 / OD-65 / OD-75)
failThreshold: any field_sources row for a settled ipos field written in the last 24 h whose previous_value equals the stored value (IDENTICAL_RESTAMP), whose new source the writer's getSourcePriority ranks equal or lower than the previous source (EQUAL_RANK_REWRITE / LOWER_RANK_REWRITE), or whose source changed its own value where allowsSameSourceRefresh grants it no refresh (SELF_CHANGE_REWRITE, OD-75); an exchange postponing a date it stated (OD-35) and a later offer document are allowed because the writer allows them
unverifiableWhen: never — always runs against field_sources joined to ipos
